basis: Latest 1.9.6.1 package including the HPC dispatch hotfix.
implementation: Direct GIG Gibbs updates for half-normal hierarchy scales; exact gamma rejection envelope at small relative coefficient norms.

checks.conditional_distribution: Independent normal/half-normal density quadrature versus draws; J=1, 2 and 6; multiple scales, including small-norm rejection branch.
checks.api: Gaussian, GEV and mixed fits; individual hierarchy; active-member subsets; optional initial slope conventions; save/reload/restart; forecast; serial/parallel reproducibility.

startup.note: Startup smoke only; short chains do not establish convergence.

screen.scope: All specifications, folds, CPU plans and exact independent/shared marginal-prior matching; no MCMC.

paper.scope: All specifications, folds, CPU plans and exact independent/shared marginal-prior matching; no MCMC.

checks.packaging: Wheel built without network/build isolation, installed into an isolated target and imported; GIG scale update executed from installed wheel.

limitations: No VSC or BIOBOT production jobs submitted.
Smoke chains verify execution, not posterior convergence or scientific robustness.
Runtime tests used Python 3.12; Python 3.10-compatible syntax was checked across source files.
An exact conditional update does not remove dependence between Gibbs blocks.
